title: Shift
summary: Type uppercase A–Z with a brief Shift hold, then return to lowercase in names and sentences.
intro: Type uppercase A–Z with a brief Shift hold, then return to lowercase in names and sentences.

screens.text: Hold Shift while you type the capital-letter drill.
screens.content: FJFF AJJS DGAS FJDG SAFJ GDFA

screens.text: Keep a steady rhythm as you hold Shift for each capital letter.
screens.content: FJAD SGDF AJGF DSFA GJFD FASD JGAF DFGS FJAF

screens.text: Use Shift smoothly while changing between the capital-letter patterns.
screens.content: DSJF GAFD FJSG AJDF GDSF FJDA SGAJ FDGF FJAF

screens.text: Finish the capital-letter drill with calm, even Shift presses.
screens.content: JAFG DSFJ AGDF FJGS DAFJ SGFD JGAS FDFG FJAF
